reasoning: A loss of one third leaves two thirds each year. After six years, the mass is 4(2/3)^6 = 256/729 kg. This simplified fraction is equivalent to Math Academy's stated expression.

answers.ma_evidence: Repeating this pattern, we see that the mass after $\color{blue}6$ years is $4\cdot \left(\dfrac 2 3\right)^{\color{blue}6}\,\textrm{kg}.$
